title: Tuckkwiowhum Campground

services.name: Central Campsites
services.desc: There is an upper and lower section to our riverside sites, with the lower section being closer to the beautiful Fraser River. The riverside sites offer stunning mountain and water views. Water is available to all riverside sites and each have firepits. These sites are close to washroom/shower facilities. The upper section consists of five large sites that rest on gentle slopes, with some having level areas for tent trailers, small travel trailers, truck/campers and tents. The lower section has beautiful views and level ground for your smaller recreational vehicles. During the annual spring run-off, the Fraser River rises to levels that make the riverside and creekside sites unavailable
